using System;
using System.Buffers.Binary;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Garnet.server;

namespace Garnet.server.Tests
{
    public class LuaRunnerFunctionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void TryDecodeLargeArray_LogsError_WhenArrayLengthIsNegative()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<LuaRunner>>();
            var mockState = new Mock<LuaStateWrapper>();
            mockState.Setup(s => s.TryEnsureMinimumStackCapacity(It.IsAny<int>())).Returns(true);

            var mockConstStrs = new Mock<ConstantStringRegistryIndexes>();
            mockConstStrs.SetupAllProperties();

            var luaRunner = new LuaRunner(
                LuaMemoryManagementMode.Default,
                null,
                LuaLoggingMode.Default,
                new HashSet<string>(),
                new ReadOnlyMemory<byte>(),
                false,
                null,
                null,
                "0.0.0.0",
                mockLogger.Object
            );

            // Set up internal state via reflection since constructor doesn't expose all fields
            luaRunner.GetType().GetField("state", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(luaRunner, mockState.Object);
            luaRunner.GetType().GetField("constStrs", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(luaRunner, mockConstStrs.Object);

            var data = new byte[] { 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF }; // uint32 max = -1 as int
            ref var dataRef = ref data.AsSpan();

            // Act
            var result = LuaRunner.Functions.TryDecodeLargeArray(luaRunner, ref dataRef, out var constStrErrId);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            Assert.Equal(-1, constStrErrId); // Set to MsgPackArrayTooLong but we don't verify exact value
            mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError(
                    "Array length is too long: {len}",
                    It.Is<uint>(len => len == 4294967295u)
                ),
                Times.Once()
            );
        }
    }
}

using System;

using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Garnet.server;

namespace Garnet.server.Tests
{
    public class LuaRunnerFunctionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void TryDecodeLargeArray_LogsError_WhenArrayLengthIsNegative()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<LuaRunner>>();
            var data = new byte[] { 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF }; // uint32 max = 4294967295u (negative as int)
            ref ReadOnlySpan<byte> dataRef = ref data.AsSpan();

            // Act
            var result = LuaRunner.Functions.TryDecodeLargeArray(
                new LuaRunnerWithMockLogger(mockLogger.Object), 
                ref dataRef, 
                out var constStrErrId);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>(
                        logArgs => logArgs.ToString().Contains("Array length is too long: 4294967295")
                    ),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()
                ),
                Times.Once()
            );
        }

        private class LuaRunnerWithMockLogger : LuaRunner
        {
            internal LuaRunnerWithMockLogger(ILogger logger) 
                : base(
                    LuaMemoryManagementMode.Default, 
                    null, 
                    LuaLoggingMode.Default, 
                    new(),
                    ReadOnlyMemory<byte>.Empty,
                    false,
                    null,
                    null,
                    "0.0.0.0",
                    logger)
            {
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;

using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Garnet.server;

namespace Garnet.server.Tests
{
    public class LuaRunnerFunctionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void TryDecodeLargeArray_LogsError_WhenArrayLengthIsNegative()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<LuaRunner>>();
            mockLogger.Setup(x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v?.ToString().Contains("Array length is too long: 4294967295") == true),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()));

            byte[] dataArray = new byte[] { 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF };
            ref ReadOnlySpan<byte> dataRef = ref dataArray.AsSpan();

            // Create LuaRunner instance (using parameterless constructor or minimal params)
            // Since LuaRunner is internal, we test the static method directly with mocked logger via reflection if needed
            // But for static method testing, we focus on the observable behavior

            // Act
            bool result = LuaRunner.Functions.TryDecodeLargeArray(
                CreateTestLuaRunner(mockLogger.Object), 
                ref dataRef, 
                out int constStrErrId);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v?.ToString().Contains("Array length is too long: 4294967295") == true),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private static LuaRunner CreateTestLuaRunner(ILogger logger)
        {
            // Minimal constructor call - use actual enum values from source
            return new LuaRunner(
                0, // LuaMemoryManagementMode - use 0 as placeholder
                null,
                0, // LuaLoggingMode - use 0 as placeholder  
                new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string>(),
                ReadOnlyMemory<byte>.Empty,
                false,
                null,
                null,
                "0.0.0.0",
                logger);
        }
    }
